notes: All required story categories covered with no duplication.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S1.title: Define Timeout State Schema and UX Contract
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S1.description: Define frontend state model for long-running requests including timeout threshold, modal visibility, retry state, aborted request flags, and idempotent resume behavior. Establish contract for continue vs abandon behavior including state persistence across re-renders.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S2.title: Implement Timeout Detection and Retry Logic
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S2.description: Implement core logic using timers and AbortController to detect long-running requests (~45s), trigger timeout state, allow continuation of request without duplication, or safely abort and reset state with cleanup of pending promises.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S3.title: Build Timeout Modal UI and User Actions
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S3.description: Implement timeout modal with clear messaging and actions: Continue waiting or Abandon request. Ensure proper UX state transitions, accessibility (focus trap, keyboard actions), and message continuity.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S4.title: Unit Tests for Timeout and Abort Scenarios
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S4.description: Create unit tests for timeout trigger timing, AbortController cancellation, retry flows, and state transitions including edge cases (rapid user actions, duplicate requests, unmounted component cleanup).

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S5.title: End-to-End Integration of Timeout UX Flow
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S5.description: Validate full flow from user message submission through long-running backend response, timeout modal display, user decision (continue/abandon), and final UI state consistency including no duplicate responses or orphaned requests.
